description: This file defines the SoapResourceObserver class, which extends ResourceObserver to handle SOAP-based notifications for resource management errors in a CRM system. It includes methods to set the SOAP server instance and to notify clients of errors via SOAP responses.

classes.name: SoapResourceObserver
classes.description: A class that manages SOAP notifications for resource errors, extending ResourceObserver.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the observer with a specific module.

methods.name: set_soap_server
methods.description: Assigns a SOAP server instance to the observer.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a SOAP response to indicate a resource management error to clients.
